summary: Check that a host name reaches this server

host_type.description: The host type of the name

host_id.description: The saved host the name belongs to; leave it out for a host not saved yet. A host that overrides the ACME challenge path answers `overridden`

name.description: A plain host name (no wildcard, no pattern)

result.description: `reachable`: the request to this server's public address came back with the proof; `could-not-confirm`: no answer; `router-answered`: something other than this server answered; `no-public-address`: no public IPv4 was found; `overridden`: the host overrides the challenge path

detail.description: A short note on the result

address.description: The public address that was probed

400.description: The name is a wildcard or a pattern, or not one of the host's names

403.description: The user may not manage this host type

404.description: The host does not exist or the user may not see it

description:
Writes a one-time token file under the ACME challenge path, asks this server's confirmed public IPv4 for it (port 80, then 443) with the name as Host and SNI, and removes the file. It connects only to that public address, never to a typed or resolved one. A result of the last 10 minutes lets the save of the same name follow without a second probe. It never says "unreachable": an answer from inside the network cannot tell.

Needs: the manage right of the host type
